intent_summary: Timestamped observations are normalized to UTC, ordered, and checked against their declared cadence before analysis.

criteria.criterion: Timestamped datasets provide both timestamps and frequency; positional datasets provide neither.
criteria.notes: Partial coordinate metadata and positional as_of are rejected.

criteria.criterion: Local timestamps require a timezone, and ambiguous or nonexistent daylight-saving times require an explicit offset.
criteria.notes: UTC round trips detect ambiguous/nonexistent local times; valid local time normalizes to the expected UTC hour.

criteria.criterion: Duplicate timestamps are rejected unless an aggregation policy is supplied; duplicate counts and transformations remain visible.
criteria.notes: Explicit mean/sum handling retains duplicate counts and transformation descriptions. Nulls propagate rather than becoming zero.

criteria.criterion: An as_of cutoff excludes later observations, and cadence is checked as a fixed elapsed duration.
criteria.notes: Filtering is inclusive through as_of; cadence compares UTC elapsed timedeltas, including fixed seven-day weeks.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
